description_en: Queries the configuration of a serverless cluster
name: DescribeDBClusterServerlessConf

parameters.help_en: The ID of the serverless cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

AgileScaleMax.description_en: The maximum capacity, in PCUs, for a cluster in agile mode. In agile mode, the cluster consists of only serverless nodes

AllowShutDown.description_en:
Indicates whether the no-activity suspension feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled

false: Disabled (Default)
AllowShutDown.description_zh:
是否开启无活动暂停。取值：

true：开启

false：关闭（默认）

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the serverless cluster

ScaleApRoNumMax.description_en: The maximum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15
ScaleApRoNumMax.description_zh: 只读列存节点个数上限。取值范围：0～15

ScaleApRoNumMin.description_en: The minimum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15
ScaleApRoNumMin.description_zh: 只读列存节点个数下限。取值范围：0～15

ScaleMax.description_en: The maximum compute capacity of a single node in PCUs. Valid values: 1 to 32
ScaleMax.description_zh: 单节点伸缩上限。取值范围：1 PCU~32 PCU

ScaleMin.description_en: The minimum compute capacity of a single node in PolarDB Capacity Units (PCUs). Valid values: 1 to 31
ScaleMin.description_zh: 单节点伸缩下限。取值范围：1 PCU~31 PCU

ScaleRoNumMax.description_en: The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15
ScaleRoNumMax.description_zh: 只读节点个数伸缩上限。取值范围：0~15

ScaleRoNumMin.description_en: The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15
ScaleRoNumMin.description_zh: 只读节点个数伸缩下限。取值范围：0~15

SecondsUntilAutoPause.description_en: The detection period for no-activity suspension, in seconds. The value must be an integer from 300 to 86,400 and must be a multiple of 300
SecondsUntilAutoPause.description_zh: 无活动暂停的检测时长。取值范围：300~86,400。单位秒。检测时长必须是300秒的倍数

ServerlessRuleMode.description_en:
The elasticity sensitivity. Valid values:

normal: Standard

flexible: Flexible
ServerlessRuleMode.description_zh:
弹性灵敏度。取值：

normal：标准
flexible：灵敏

Switchs.description_en:
Indicates whether the steady-state mode is enabled. Valid values:

1: Enabled

0: Disabled
Switchs.description_zh:
稳态是否开启。取值：

1：开启

0：关闭

TraditionalScaleMaxThreshold.description_en: The maximum capacity, in PCUs, for a cluster in steady-state mode. Steady-state mode adds serverless capabilities to nodes that have fixed specifications
TraditionalScaleMaxThreshold.description_zh: 稳态（在固定规格节点上叠加了Serverless能力）伸缩最大值
